g.text: ER subset · capture, cycle and Archive · PostgreSQL baseline 030 + 031 · as built at f6cd896
contribution_id : TEXT «FK contributions, null on delete»
Timestamps are ISO-8601 TEXT (COLLATE "C"). Integers are BIGINT. Archive = published cycles + their film job + clip jobs; there is no archive table.
media_jobs.group_id also references groups; compilation_job_inputs.clip_job_id points at a clip job in media_jobs.
